describe.who: Ife, a small 14-year-old girl, the smallest of her friends (about five and a half heads tall), with dark brown skin
design: HAIR: black hair parted in the middle and tied up in two big round afro puffs, one on each side of the top of her head

GLASSES: enormous perfectly round thin-rimmed glasses; the lenses are clear, so her skin and her eyes show through them exactly as the rest of her face does (never tinted, never the background colour)
JUMPER: an oversized plain pale-green knitted jumper with a thick rolled turtle neck, ribbed hem and cuffs, and baggy sleeves that come down to her knuckles
SHORTS AND LEGGINGS: short plain grey shorts with a turned-up hem over plain dark navy leggings
SHOES: plain dark-grey canvas trainers with grey laces and grey soles

BACKPACK COMPUTER: a boxy beige retro computer worn on her back as a backpack with two beige shoulder straps over the jumper; from its top a short grey jointed metal arm holds a small beige CRT monitor in the air above HER LEFT shoulder, beside her head, its dark-green screen facing forward with a few rows of small bright-green dashes on it; three short loose cables (red, yellow, blue) hang from the bottom of the pack
FACE: big round dark eyes, small worried eyebrows, a small mouth
describe.never: No pins, no badges, no emblems, no insignia, no stars, no lettering, no numbers, no logos and no brand marks anywhere on her. Nothing readable on the screen. Her hands are empty.

acting.run: she scurries with short quick steps, leaning in, elbows tight and fists pumping high, eyes wide and worried; the backpack computer bounces on her back and its monitor wobbles on its arm, the cables swinging
acting.runtop: a quick scurry with short steps; from above her two round black hair puffs, the pale-green jumper's shoulders, the beige backpack computer on her back and its small monitor on its arm beside her head (on HER LEFT, the viewer's left) are what show
